bias.en: Bearish · broke the Oct 16 low, RSI under 30
bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 10 月 16 日低点，RSI 低于 30

read.en: Applied Materials fell 2.0% on Oct 20 to $404.98, trading between $399.02 and $412.40. It is below the falling 5-day ($420.8), 10-day ($460.3), 30-day ($470.9) and 100-day ($516.0) averages and the rising 200-day ($440.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, with the gap still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($494.02), and RSI is 29.3, oversold.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月20日下跌 2.0%，收于 $404.98，盘中区间 $399.02–412.40。股价位于下行的 5 日（$420.8）、10 日（$460.3）、30 日（$470.9）和 100 日均线（$516.0）及上行的 200 日均线（$440.5）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，差距仍在扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$494.02），RSI 为 29.3，处于超卖区。

read.en: The close broke the $407.3 Oct 16 low, which now turns into resistance, while the $397 May 19 low held at the day's low of $399. Resistance is $407.3, then $418–421 (Oct 15 low, 5-day average) and $440.5 (200-day). Support is $397–399, then $377–380 (April lows). A close below $397 would open $377–380; a close above $421 would target $440.
read.zh: 收盘跌破 $407.3 的 10月16日低点，该位转为阻力；$397 的 5月19日低点在盘中低点 $399 处守住。阻力为 $407.3，其次 $418–421（10月15日低点、5 日均线）和 $440.5（200 日均线）。支撑为 $397–399，其次 $377–380（4月低点）。若收盘跌破 $397，下一目标看 $377–380；若收盘站上 $421，下一目标看 $440。
